airlines.note: No hedges on its fuel use, but it owns the Monroe refinery near Philadelphia, which supplies part of its jet fuel. Its only fuel derivatives cover the refinery's inventory.

airlines.note: Policy is not to hedge fuel.

airlines.note: A 1¢ a gallon rise in fuel adds about $50 million to its annual fuel bill.
